show.description:
the heart-touching story of Anika, a 9-year-old orphan with dreams bigger than her circumstances. Determined to complete her education, she searches for support—but the world turns its back on her.
One fateful day, Anika crosses paths with a wealthy man when she suddenly appears in front of his car. Moved by her struggles, he becomes her benefactor and helps her continue her studies. Wanting to give her a permanent home, he asks his younger brother to adopt her.
But Anika refuses. She believes that one day her real family will return for her.
Will Anika’s faith be rewarded? Or will the rich man become the only guardian in her life? And above all—why did her family abandon her in the first place?
